==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. I donned a Lucid Light gas mask. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.)

I commanded the Reality Warping Stone to take a humanoid form and battle the Were-Rhino. (The Reality Warping Stone resembles a jagged diamond that is half pink and half yellow.) (Were-Rhinos resemble humanoid rhinos.)

I banished the defeated opponent's toxic dust into space. (I went on this adventure to defeat the Were-Rhino, because I knew that the choking dust that harmed me in a previous dream was produced by them. That's why they weren't affected in a previous dream, when they tried to challenge me for the Reality Warping Stone. They had initially got the drop on me, so this was me getting the drop on them.)
